from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.functions import (
    avg,
    sum as spark_sum,
    count,
    countDistinct,
    col,
    first,
    max as spark_max,
    desc,
    year,
    month
)

# ============================================================
# Paths
# ============================================================

STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "stnvdaanna2026"

GOLD_PATH = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "tweets_stock/historical/"
)

PREDICTION_ROOT = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "prediction/streaming/"
)

AGG_ROOT = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "aggregates/"
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, DateType, DoubleType


def merge_daily_tweets(historical, envelopes):
    """BI-only merge: preserve real tweet time and historical ML labels."""
    if "tweets" not in envelopes.columns:
        raise ValueError("Stream archive is missing the tweets array")
    # No inferred element schema when every archived response has an empty array.
    if not hasattr(envelopes.schema["tweets"].dataType.elementType, "fields"):
        if envelopes.filter(F.size("tweets") > 0).limit(1).count():
            raise ValueError("Stream tweets must be JSON objects")
        return historical
    source_file = F.col("_source_file") if "_source_file" in envelopes.columns else F.lit("")
    stream = envelopes.select(
        F.to_timestamp("generated_at_utc").alias("_observed_at"),
        source_file.alias("_source_file"), F.explode("tweets").alias("tweet")
    ).select("tweet.*", "_observed_at", "_source_file")
    required = {"tweet_id", "user_id", "tweet_timestamp_utc"}
    if not required.issubset(stream.columns):
        raise ValueError("Stream tweet is missing identity or UTC timestamp fields")
    stream = (stream.withColumn("tweet_timestamp_utc", F.to_timestamp("tweet_timestamp_utc"))
              .withColumn("tweet_timestamp_et", F.from_utc_timestamp("tweet_timestamp_utc", "America/New_York")))
    if stream.filter(F.col("tweet_timestamp_utc").isNull() | F.col("tweet_id").isNull()
                     | (F.trim("tweet_id") == "") | F.col("user_id").isNull()
                     | (F.trim("user_id") == "")).limit(1).count():
        raise ValueError("Invalid stream tweet identity or timestamp; aggregates unchanged")
    # Overlapping collection windows and reruns must not count a tweet twice.
    stream = (stream.withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(
        Window.partitionBy("tweet_id").orderBy(F.col("_observed_at").desc_nulls_last(),
                                               F.col("_source_file").desc())))
        .filter(F.col("_rn") == 1).drop("_rn"))
    # Ingestion's candidate session is not a tweet date or an authoritative ML label.
    protected = {"prediction_session_date", "next_trading_date", "next_available_volume",
                 "current_open", "current_close", "current_high", "current_low", "current_volume"}
    stream = stream.select(*[
        (F.col(field.name) if field.name in stream.columns and field.name not in protected
         else F.lit(None)).cast(field.dataType).alias(field.name)
        for field in historical.schema.fields
    ])
    merged = historical.alias("h").join(stream.alias("s"), on="tweet_id", how="full")
    return merged.select(F.col("tweet_id"), *[
        F.coalesce(F.col("s." + c), F.col("h." + c)).alias(c)
        for c in historical.columns if c != "tweet_id"
    ])


def completed_market_frame(stock_pdf, end_date):
    """One completed Yahoo bar per market date; end_date is exclusive."""
    import pandas as pd
    import math
    pdf = stock_pdf.copy()
    if isinstance(pdf.columns, pd.MultiIndex):
        pdf.columns = pdf.columns.get_level_values(0)
    pdf = pdf.reset_index()
    fields = ["Open", "Close", "High", "Low", "Volume"]
    if not {"Date", *fields}.issubset(pdf.columns):
        raise ValueError("Yahoo market response is missing OHLCV columns")
    rows = []
    for _, row in pdf.iterrows():
        market_date = pd.Timestamp(row["Date"]).date()
        values = [float(row[c]) for c in fields]
        if market_date < end_date and all(math.isfinite(v) and v > 0 for v in values):
            rows.append((market_date, *values))
    if not rows:
        raise ValueError("No completed market bars; refusing to overwrite market aggregates")
    schema = StructType([StructField("tweet_created_at_date", DateType(), False)] + [
        StructField("current_" + c.lower(), DoubleType(), False) for c in fields
    ])
    return spark.createDataFrame(rows, schema).dropDuplicates(["tweet_created_at_date"])


def build_market_summary(tweets, market, historical, predictions):
    """Calendar-date OHLCV is independent of tweet coverage; forecast uses session D."""
    sentiment = tweets.groupBy("tweet_created_at_date").agg(
        F.avg("sentiment_score").alias("avg_sentiment"), F.count("*").alias("tweet_count"))
    summary = market.join(sentiment, on="tweet_created_at_date", how="full")
    # The forecast made in session D and its next-session actual belong together.
    # Do not join a forecast on target D while using the label for D+1.
    labels = (historical.groupBy("prediction_session_date")
              .agg(F.max("next_available_volume").cast("double").alias("actual_volume"))
              .withColumnRenamed("prediction_session_date", "tweet_created_at_date"))
    summary = summary.join(labels, on="tweet_created_at_date", how="left")
    if predictions is not None:
        latest = (predictions.withColumn("tweet_created_at_date", F.to_date("prediction_session_date"))
                  .withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("tweet_created_at_date")
                              .orderBy(F.col("prediction_generated_at_utc").desc())))
                  .filter(F.col("_rn") == 1)
                  .select("tweet_created_at_date", F.col("predicted_next_volume").cast("double").alias("predicted_volume")))
        summary = summary.join(latest, on="tweet_created_at_date", how="left")
    else:
        summary = summary.withColumn("predicted_volume", F.lit(None).cast("double"))
    return (summary.withColumn("tweet_count", F.coalesce("tweet_count", F.lit(0).cast("long")))
            .withColumn("prediction_accuracy", F.when(
                (F.col("actual_volume") > 0) & F.col("predicted_volume").isNotNull(),
                1 - F.abs(F.col("actual_volume") - F.col("predicted_volume")) / F.col("actual_volume")))
            .select("tweet_created_at_date", "current_open", "current_close", "current_high", "current_low",
                    "current_volume", "actual_volume", "avg_sentiment", "tweet_count", "predicted_volume", "prediction_accuracy"))


# ============================================================
# Read Historical Gold and archived daily tweets for BI
# ============================================================
spark.conf.set("spark.sql.session.timeZone", "UTC")
STREAM_ROOT = f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/stream/"
historical_bi_df = spark.read.parquet(GOLD_PATH)
# Fail visibly on missing/inaccessible stream archives; do not silently publish
# historical-only BI data after a daily source failure.
stream_envelopes = (spark.read.option("multiline", "true")
                    .option("mode", "FAILFAST")
                    .option("recursiveFileLookup", "true")
                    .option("pathGlobFilter", "tweets_gold.json")
                    .json(STREAM_ROOT)
                    .withColumn("_source_file", F.input_file_name()))
df = merge_daily_tweets(historical_bi_df, stream_envelopes)
df = df.withColumn("tweet_created_at_date", F.to_date("tweet_timestamp_et"))
print("BI historical source:", GOLD_PATH)
print("BI daily source:", STREAM_ROOT)
display(df.groupBy("tweet_created_at_date").count().orderBy(F.col("tweet_created_at_date").desc()))

# Fetch current-market bars independently of whether tweets exist that day.
# End date matches BackfillRetrain's conservative evening completion cutoff.
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import yfinance as yf
now_et = datetime.now(ZoneInfo("America/New_York"))
market_end = now_et.date() + timedelta(days=1 if now_et.hour >= 18 else 0)
first_tweet_date = df.agg(F.min("tweet_created_at_date").alias("d")).first()["d"]
market_start = min(first_tweet_date, now_et.date() - timedelta(days=30)) if first_tweet_date else now_et.date() - timedelta(days=30)
stock_pdf = yf.download("NVDA", start=market_start.isoformat(), end=market_end.isoformat(),
                        auto_adjust=False, progress=False)
market_daily_df = completed_market_frame(stock_pdf, market_end)
print("Completed market range:", market_start, market_end, "(end exclusive)")

# ============================================================
# Read streaming predictions
# ============================================================
predicted_df = (spark.read.option("recursiveFileLookup", "true").parquet(PREDICTION_ROOT))
print("Prediction rows =", predicted_df.count())

# ============================================================
# 1. USER PROFILE
# Original project:
# per-user profile / credibility / influencer attributes
#
# 2026 adaptation:
# account_favourites_count, listed_count and
# follower_activity_score are unavailable in current API schema,
# so they are intentionally omitted.
# ============================================================

user_profile_df = (
    df.groupBy("user_id")
    .agg(
        first("is_blue_verified", ignorenulls=True).alias("is_blue_verified"),
        spark_max("account_created_date").alias("account_created_at"),
        spark_max("account_age_days").alias("account_age_days"),
        first("is_new_account", ignorenulls=True).alias("is_new_account"),
        first("is_influencer", ignorenulls=True).alias("is_influencer"),
        spark_max("followers_count").alias("followers_count"),
        spark_max("friends_count").alias("friends_count"),
        spark_max("media_count").alias("media_count"),
        avg("credibility_score").alias("credibility_score")
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 2. DAILY TWEET SUMMARY
# ============================================================

daily_tweet_summary = (
    df.groupBy("tweet_created_at_date")
    .agg(
        count("*").alias("total_tweets"),

        avg("sentiment_score").alias("avg_sentiment"),

        avg("interaction_score").alias(
            "avg_interaction_score"
        ),

        avg("favorite_ratio").alias(
            "avg_favorite_ratio"
        ),

        avg("reply_ratio").alias(
            "avg_reply_ratio"
        ),

        spark_sum(
            col("is_viral").cast("int")
        ).alias("total_viral_tweet"),

        avg("credibility_score").alias(
            "avg_credibility_score"
        ),

        avg("followers_count").alias(
            "avg_followers"
        )
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 3. MARKET SUMMARY PER DAY
# ============================================================

market_summary_per_day = build_market_summary(
    df, market_daily_df, historical_bi_df, predicted_df
)


# ============================================================
# 4. VIRAL TWEET LOG
# ============================================================

viral_tweet_log = (
    df.filter(col("is_viral") == True)
    .select(
        "tweet_id",
        "user_id",
        "tweet_created_at_date",
        "full_text",
        "sentiment_score",
        "interaction_score",
        "followers_count",
        "favorite_count",
        "retweet_count",
        "reply_count",
        "view_count",
        "credibility_score"
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 5. USER TYPE DISTRIBUTION PER DAY
# ============================================================

user_type_distribution_per_day = (
    df.groupBy("tweet_created_at_date")
    .agg(
        spark_sum(
            col("is_influencer").cast("int")
        ).alias("influencer_tweet_count"),

        spark_sum(
            col("is_new_account").cast("int")
        ).alias("new_account_tweet_count"),

        spark_sum(
            col("is_blue_verified").cast("int")
        ).alias("blue_verified_tweet_count"),

        count("*").alias("total_tweets"),

        countDistinct("user_id").alias(
            "distinct_users"
        ),

        avg("account_age_days").alias(
            "avg_account_age"
        )
    )
)

# Extra complementary counts make Power BI donut charts easy.
user_type_distribution_per_day = (
    user_type_distribution_per_day

    .withColumn(
        "general_public_tweet_count",
        col("total_tweets")
        - col("influencer_tweet_count")
    )

    .withColumn(
        "established_account_tweet_count",
        col("total_tweets")
        - col("new_account_tweet_count")
    )

    .withColumn(
        "unverified_tweet_count",
        col("total_tweets")
        - col("blue_verified_tweet_count")
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 6. TOP USERS BY TWEET COUNT
# ============================================================

top_users_by_tweet_count = (
    df.groupBy("user_id")
    .agg(
        count("*").alias("tweet_count"),
        spark_max("followers_count").alias(
            "followers_count"
        ),
        avg("credibility_score").alias(
            "credibility_score"
        ),
        first("is_influencer", ignorenulls=True).alias(
            "is_influencer"
        )
    )
    .orderBy(desc("tweet_count"))
)


# ============================================================
# 7. TOP USERS BY VIRAL TWEETS
# ============================================================

top_users_by_viral_tweets = (
    df.filter(col("is_viral") == True)
    .groupBy("user_id")
    .agg(
        count("*").alias("viral_tweet_count"),

        avg("interaction_score").alias(
            "avg_interaction_score"
        ),

        spark_max("followers_count").alias(
            "followers_count"
        ),

        avg("credibility_score").alias(
            "credibility_score"
        )
    )
    .orderBy(desc("viral_tweet_count"))
)


# ============================================================
# 8. INFLUENCER MONTHLY ENGAGEMENT
# ============================================================

influencer_monthly_engagement = (
    df.filter(col("is_influencer") == True)
    .groupBy(
        year("tweet_created_at_date").alias("year"),
        month("tweet_created_at_date").alias("month")
    )
    .agg(
        count("*").alias(
            "influencer_tweet_count"
        ),

        avg("sentiment_score").alias(
            "avg_sentiment_score"
        ),

        avg("interaction_score").alias(
            "avg_interaction"
        ),

        countDistinct("user_id").alias(
            "distinct_influencers"
        ),

        spark_sum("favorite_count").alias(
            "total_favorites"
        ),

        spark_sum("retweet_count").alias(
            "total_retweets"
        ),

        spark_sum("reply_count").alias(
            "total_replies"
        )
    )
)

# Power BI-friendly month date
influencer_monthly_engagement = (
    influencer_monthly_engagement
    .withColumn(
        "year_month",
        F.to_date(
            F.concat_ws(
                "-",
                col("year").cast("string"),
                F.lpad(
                    col("month").cast("string"),
                    2,
                    "0"
                ),
                F.lit("01")
            )
        )
    )

aggregate_tables = {
    "user_profile": user_profile_df,
    "daily_tweet_summary": daily_tweet_summary,
    "market_summary_per_day": market_summary_per_day,
    "viral_tweet_log": viral_tweet_log,
    "user_type_distribution_per_day": user_type_distribution_per_day,
    "top_users_by_tweet_count": top_users_by_tweet_count,
    "top_users_by_viral_tweets": top_users_by_viral_tweets,
    "influencer_monthly_engagement": influencer_monthly_engagement
}

print("=" * 70)
print("GOLD AGGREGATE DQ")
print("=" * 70)

for name, table_df in aggregate_tables.items():
    print(f"{name:40s} rows = {table_df.count()}")

print("=" * 70)

display(daily_tweet_summary.orderBy("tweet_created_at_date"))
display(market_summary_per_day.orderBy("tweet_created_at_date"))
display(top_users_by_tweet_count.limit(10))
display(top_users_by_viral_tweets.limit(10))

OUTPUT_PATHS = {
    "user_profile":
        f"{AGG_ROOT}user_profile/",

    "daily_tweet_summary":
        f"{AGG_ROOT}daily_tweet_summary/",

    "market_summary_per_day":
        f"{AGG_ROOT}market_summary_per_day/",

    "viral_tweet_log":
        f"{AGG_ROOT}viral_tweet_log/",

    "user_type_distribution_per_day":
        f"{AGG_ROOT}user_type_distribution_per_day/",

    "top_users_by_tweet_count":
        f"{AGG_ROOT}top_users_by_tweet_count/",

    "top_users_by_viral_tweets":
        f"{AGG_ROOT}top_users_by_viral_tweets/",

    "influencer_monthly_engagement":
        f"{AGG_ROOT}influencer_monthly_engagement/"
}

for name, table_df in aggregate_tables.items():

    path = OUTPUT_PATHS[name]

    print(f"Writing {name}")
    print(path)

    (
        table_df
        .coalesce(1)
        .write
        .mode("overwrite")
        .parquet(path)
    )

print("\nAll 8 Gold Aggregate datasets written successfully.")

print("=" * 70)
print("READ-BACK VALIDATION")
print("=" * 70)

for name, path in OUTPUT_PATHS.items():

    check_df = spark.read.parquet(path)

    print(
        f"{name:40s}",
        f"rows={check_df.count():5d}",
        f"cols={len(check_df.columns):2d}"
    )

print("=" * 70)
print("GoldAggregate COMPLETE")

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import *

# Reuse the configured source/output roots from the first cell.
PREDICTION_AGG_PATH = f"{AGG_ROOT}prediction_history/"

# ============================================================
# 1. Read all historical streaming predictions
# ============================================================

pred = (
    spark.read
    .option("recursiveFileLookup", "true")
    .parquet(PREDICTION_ROOT)
)

print("Prediction schema:")
pred.printSchema()

display(pred.limit(20))

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

# Use the SAME configured production root as the other Gold aggregates.
# Never override the account/path here or evaluate staging data.
HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH = GOLD_PATH
PREDICTION_AGG_PATH = f"{AGG_ROOT}prediction_history/"
spark.catalog.refreshByPath(HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH)
historical_gold = spark.read.parquet(HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH)
print("Prediction evaluation production source:", HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH)
print("Prediction history output:", PREDICTION_AGG_PATH)

# Mapping and labels have different grains. A session resolves a target date;
# the target date resolves its volume, regardless of which tweet/session holds it.
session_targets = (
    historical_gold.select(
        F.to_date("prediction_session_date").alias("prediction_session_date"),
        F.to_date("next_trading_date").alias("mapped_target_date")
    )
    .filter(F.col("prediction_session_date").isNotNull()
            & F.col("mapped_target_date").isNotNull())
    .distinct()
)
if (session_targets.groupBy("prediction_session_date").count()
        .filter(F.col("count") > 1).limit(1).count()):
    raise ValueError("Historical Gold has multiple target dates for a prediction session.")

# next_available_volume is the label for next_trading_date, NOT the current
# prediction_session_date. current_volume is not the next-session actual.
target_labels = (
    historical_gold.select(
        F.to_date("next_trading_date").alias("target_date"),
        F.col("next_available_volume").cast("double").alias("actual_volume")
    )
    .filter(F.col("target_date").isNotNull()
            & (F.col("actual_volume") > 0)
            & ~F.isnan("actual_volume")
            & (F.col("actual_volume") < F.lit(float("inf"))))
    .groupBy("target_date")
    .agg(F.max("actual_volume").alias("actual_volume"),
         F.countDistinct("actual_volume").alias("_label_count"))
)
if target_labels.filter(F.col("_label_count") > 1).limit(1).count():
    raise ValueError("Historical Gold has conflicting actual volumes for a target date.")
target_labels = target_labels.drop("_label_count")

w = Window.partitionBy("prediction_session_date").orderBy(
    F.col("prediction_generated_at_utc").desc())
pred_latest = (
    pred.withColumn("prediction_session_date", F.to_date("prediction_session_date"))
    .withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("_rn") == 1).drop("_rn")
)
# Preserve an archived target when present; old archives only store the session.
archived_target = (
    F.to_date("target_date") if "target_date" in pred_latest.columns
    else F.to_date("next_trading_date") if "next_trading_date" in pred_latest.columns
    else F.lit(None).cast("date")
)
pred_latest = pred_latest.withColumn("_archived_target", archived_target)
prediction_targets = (
    pred_latest.alias("p")
    .join(session_targets.alias("m"), on="prediction_session_date", how="left")
    .select("p.*", F.coalesce(F.col("p._archived_target"),
                              F.col("m.mapped_target_date")).alias("_target_date"))
)
evaluated = (
    prediction_targets.alias("p")
    .join(target_labels.alias("a"),
          F.col("p._target_date") == F.col("a.target_date"), "left")
)
prediction_history = evaluated.select(
    F.col("p.prediction_session_date").alias("prediction_date"),
    F.col("p._target_date").alias("target_date"),
    F.col("p.predicted_next_volume").alias("predicted_volume"),
    F.col("a.actual_volume"),
    F.when(F.col("a.actual_volume") > 0,
           1 - F.abs(F.col("a.actual_volume") - F.col("p.predicted_next_volume"))
           / F.col("a.actual_volume")).alias("prediction_accuracy"),
    F.when(F.col("a.actual_volume").isNotNull(), F.lit("Evaluated"))
     .otherwise(F.lit("Pending")).alias("evaluation_status"),
    F.col("p.model_version"),
    F.col("p.prediction_generated_at_utc"),
    F.col("p.tweet_count"),
    F.col("p.avg_sentiment_score"),
    F.col("p.avg_interaction_score")
)

print("Available production labels by target date:")
display(target_labels.orderBy(F.col("target_date").desc()))
print("Prediction evaluation results:")
display(prediction_history.orderBy(F.col("prediction_date").desc()))

prediction_history.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").parquet(PREDICTION_AGG_PATH)
print("Prediction history written successfully.")
